description: This file declares the API for validating TrueTypeGX/AAT tables in the FreeType project, including functions for validation and freeing resources, as well as constants and macros for table validation flags.

methods.name: FT_TrueTypeGX_Validate
methods.description: Validates various TrueTypeGX tables to ensure offsets and indices are valid; returns an error code.

methods.name: FT_TrueTypeGX_Free
methods.description: Frees the buffer allocated by the TrueTypeGX validator.

methods.name: FT_ClassicKern_Validate
methods.description: Validates classic (16-bit format) kern tables for correctness.

methods.name: FT_ClassicKern_Free
methods.description: Frees the buffer allocated by the classic kern validator.
